# LESEKESE Products
> Nigeria's fast-acting instant insecticide for bedbugs, cockroaches, mosquitoes and household pests. Instant knockdown with 3+ days of residual protection. Sold in 100ml, 250ml and 500ml bottles at distributor stores nationwide, or order via WhatsApp.

## Key Pages
- [Products & Prices](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/products): LESEKESE 100ml, 250ml and 500ml heavy duty instant killer with retail pricing, bulk and wholesale options.
- [How It Works](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/how-it-works): How LESEKESE delivers instant knockdown and residual protection, plus safe application steps.
- [Find a Distributor](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/locations): Authorised stockists in Lagos (Fagba, Ikeja, Surulere, Lekki), Abuja (Wuse II) and Port Harcourt.
- [Contact & Bulk Orders](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/contact): Submit bulk order, retailer or distributor inquiries for dispatch within 24-48 hours.
- [Safety Data Sheet & Usage Guide](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/safety): Handling, storage and first aid guidance for LESEKESE.
- [Refund & Replacement Policy](https://www.lesekeseproducts.com/refunds): Return and replacement terms for damaged or defective products.
